name: Rattlecage Skull
summary: In Deathknell, novice Forsaken warlocks gather skulls from mindless undead. Venya Marthand asks for them as a test of their will before teaching them the dark arts of summoning.

sections.title: A Neophyte's Test
sections.body: In Deathknell, Venya Marthand guides newly raised Forsaken who have a gift for dark magic. She sends them to subdue Rattlecage Skeletons near the ruined smithy and bring back their severed skulls. The trial tests whether a fledgling warlock can bend creatures from beyond this world to their command. It also lays the groundwork for breaching the void and binding a first demonic servant.

faq.q: What are Rattlecage Skulls used for?
faq.answer: Venya Marthand collects three Rattlecage Skulls in Deathknell. Forsaken warlocks bring them to prove their focus and resolve before she teaches them to summon and bind an imp.

faq.q: Where do Rattlecage Skulls come from?
faq.answer: Rattlecage Skulls come from Rattlecage Skeletons, mindless undead wandering the overgrown roads and crumbling grounds near Deathknell's abandoned smithy.

faq.q: Why does Venya Marthand require skeletal skulls for a warlock trial?
faq.answer: Venya Marthand believes power eludes the ignorant, and mastery means bending outside forces to one's will. Slaying mindless skeletons and claiming their heads shows an apprentice can command chaotic energies instead of being consumed by them.

faq.q: What knowledge is granted after gathering these skulls?
aliases: what do you get from rattlecage skulls
faq.answer: After the skulls are offered, Venya Marthand teaches the secret ritual to call forth and bind an imp, giving young warlocks their first true demonic minion.

angles.text: As a Forsaken warlock, gathering these skulls is your first milestone in discipline. It proves you have the cold will to enslave your first demon.
As an Undead, shattering lesser, unthinking skeletons reflects the Forsaken belief in dominion through sheer will. Free-willed undead set themselves apart from mindless thralls.
